Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers

Class SparkMaxController

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.Controller
frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.SparkMaxController
public class SparkMaxController extends Controller
Controller implementation that wraps a REV SparkMax brushless motor controller (via the REVLib SparkMax API). Configures current limiting, soft limits, closed-loop gains, and encoder conversion factors from RealControllerConstants on construction, and follower SparkMaxes to mirror the main one.

      public void periodic()
      For PROFILED_PIDF and PROFILE control types, computes one step of the software trapezoid profile / profiled PID controller each loop and applies the result to the motor as a voltage-derived percent output (since the SparkMax has no built-in Motion Magic-style profiling); PIDF control is instead driven directly by the SparkMax's onboard closed loop in setPosition(double)/setVelocity(double). Call this from the owning subsystem's periodic().
